subject: CloudCon 2028 — demo routing, swag pickup & concierge staging plan
messages:
From: CloudCon Event Ops <event@cloudcon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Venue Services <venue@tixworks.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudCon booth: final questions on demo routing / concierge

Hi Hannah,

Final coordination request from the show ops team — we want to lock demo routing, swag pickup, and the concierge plan for Redwood's island (Aisle 4, Island 12). A few open items we need confirmation on by end of next week: 1) where demo attendees will queue so we don't block aisles, 2) scheduled times for sample-kit dropoff and vendor crate arrival, 3) whether you need a 4'x6' storage cage behind the backwall, 4) any power/dimensions changes since the last floorplan (attached v3).

Also copying Venue Services for dock window scheduling and load-in constraints.

Can you confirm who from your team will own concierge staffing and the lead time for signage art?

Thanks,
Ariela Gomez
Event Operations — CloudCon

Attachments: CFP-CloudCon-floorplan-v3.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: CloudCon Event Ops <event@cloudcon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: final questions on demo routing / concierge

Hi Ariela — thanks, received the floorplan. Quick answers up front:
- Queueing: we propose a roped queue at the front-right corner of the island (north side), with a live host to triage 1–2 minute check-ins and a dedicated 'demo start' bell to keep cadence. This keeps sightlines clear for neighboring islands.
- Sample-kit dropoff: PrimePrint/Logistics to arrive Tue 8/21 between 08:00–11:00 (we'll confirm exact window once vendor confirms).
- Storage cage: yes, request approved for a 4'x6' cage behind the backwall — helps with lockup and demo swaps.
- Power/dimensions: no changes from v3; still 120V single-phase per island.

Action items for Redwood: Marissa to own signage OK, Logan to finalize concierge staffing, Connor to share sample-kit inventory and packing list with logistics. Monica will own vendor SOW and insurance certs.

Attaching our internal sample inventory and the signage art guidelines we need vendors to follow.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Field Events, Redwood Inference

Attachments: samplekit-inventory.xlsx; signage-art-guidelines.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, CloudCon Event Ops <event@cloudcon.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 14:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: final questions on demo routing / concierge

Adding signage notes from marketing and approvals:
- Backwall headline: "Real-time Inference at Scale" must be centered, 72pt minimum for legibility at 20ft.
- Two directional signs (demo queue + concierge) approved; size 18x24 portrait. We will provide final art by 8/1.
- For sponsor co-branding alley: please keep 6" safe margin on left/right edges.

Logistics request to PrimePrint: can you confirm a hard-quote for 6 directional foamcore signs and 1 backwall print (6'x8') including lamination and freight to Moscone West, code: RED-CC28? Kara (SignHouse) — can you accommodate our art turn within 72 hours once files arrive? We will need proof for regulatory review.

Also, Connor — can you confirm the sample kit cadence? We'll need volunteers per shift listed in the staffing doc.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Field Marketing
From: Kara Miles <kmiles@signhouse.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimePrint Logistics <ops@primeprintco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: signage quote and art turnaround

Hi Marissa / Hannah — thanks for the specs. We can meet the 72-hour turnaround on art proofs and production, but we need final approved artwork by 8/4 to hit the install window. Draft estimate attached and sample flat mockups are on the link below.

Quick notes:
- Backwall (6'x8') print + 1" subsurface lamination: $1,380
- Six 18"x24" directional foamcore signs (printed both sides): $420
- Crate build + install labor (2 techs, 3 hours): $360
- Freight to Moscone West (curb-to-curb): $240

Total estimate: $2,400 (final quote attached).

Proofs: https://signhouse.co/proofs/redwood-cloudcon-cc28
Attachment: primeprint-quote-5271.pdf

Best,
Kara Miles
Production Lead — SignHouse
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudCon Event Ops <event@cloudcon.com>, Kara Miles <kmiles@signhouse.com>, PrimePrint Logistics <ops@primeprintco.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon booth: demo routing, swag pickup & concierge staging plan — final runbook

Team — consolidating final runbook and deadlines: please treat this as the single source of truth for the island. Deliverables and owners: 

1) Signage art: Marissa — finalize copy and approve art by 2028-08-01 EOD. Kara will produce proofs within 72 hours; install scheduled for 8/20–8/21.
2) Sample-kit inventory & packing: Connor — finalize samplekit-inventory.xlsx and outbound packing list by 2028-08-03; PrimePrint to confirm crate arrival window by 8/5.
3) Concierge staffing: Logan — provide shift roster (4 hosts per peak block) and QR-code check-in flow by 2028-08-07.
4) Storage cage & power: Monica — confirm permit + onsite cage dimensions with Venue Services by 2028-08-06.
5) Freight labels: use Redwood OPS code RED-CC28 and send airway bill to ops@primeprintco.com; all inbound crates must be labeled with exhibitor name + crate #.

CloudCon Ops / Venue Services — thanks for the dock windows; we request a 2-hour buffer for crate staging to avoid peak exhibitor traffic.

If there are no objections, we'll proceed with Kara's estimate and issue PO on 7/31 to lock lead time.

Ack replies are fine for signoff; please flag anything blocking.

Hannah
Head of Field Events, Redwood Inference
